page.overview:
Who is Branli?

When realizes that is also on the , he assumes that is stuck as well and is unable to get down without hurting himself. After learning that can glide down, he is excited as he thinks this could help his research. Through his research, he wants to one day himself be a bird, capable of flight.

Based on the distance flies, will have different reactions. If he flies less than 450 meters, will be upset and refuse to give a reward. He encourages to think of himself as a , free from gravity. In addition, he suggests that make adjustments to preserve his . If glides between 450 and 600 meters, considers it a small step towards his goal. He initially offers 21 as a reward, though he relents and gives a instead. Should make it more than 600 meters, notes that, while he did not flap his arms, his methods were still effective. As a reward, he gives a .

If returns to at any point after first participating in the , he will refer to him as his research assistant.
